main.description: Records a badge award to a user, project, or activity claim.

badge.description: Strong reference to the badge definition at the time of award. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.badge.definition.

subject.description: Entity the badge award is for (either an account DID or any specific AT Protocol record), e.g. a user, a project, or a specific activity claim.

note.description: Optional statement explaining the reason for this badge award.

url.description: Optional URL the badge award links to.

extensions.description: Publisher-defined supplementary data for this award. Each entry is an inline typed object with a fully qualified $type, or a strong reference to a separately stored extension record. The open union permits third-party Lexicons without adding them to the shared badge schema. Consumers must validate payloads against their own schemas and, when declared, the referenced badge definition's extensionTypes. Unknown or unavailable extensions must not prevent displaying the base award. A strong reference pins the extension to a particular record version; updates require a new reference to use the new version.

items.description: An inline third-party extension object, or a strong reference to an extension record of any Lexicon. For a strong reference, the allowed payload type is the referenced record's $type.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created

signatures.description: Optional cryptographic signatures attesting to this record's content.
